baseTemplate.title: Real-World Asset (RWA) Blockchain Co-op Student - OrionGrid
baseTemplate.description:
Join TAURUS AI CORP's OrionGrid RWA Platform team as a Co-op Student and explore the intersection of blockchain technology and real-world asset tokenization. Work on innovative solutions that bridge traditional finance with decentralized systems, enabling real-world assets to be represented and traded on the blockchain.

**About OrionGrid:**
OrionGrid is our Real-World Asset (RWA) blockchain platform that tokenizes physical and financial assets, enabling new forms of asset management, trading, and investment. You'll work on systems that connect traditional finance with blockchain technology.

**Key Responsibilities:**
- Assist in developing RWA tokenization protocols
- Contribute to smart contract development for asset management
- Help build compliance and regulatory features
- Support integration with traditional financial systems
- Participate in research on RWA standards and best practices
- Document technical specifications and compliance requirements
- Assist with testing and security audits

**Learning Opportunities:**
- Gain expertise in RWA tokenization and blockchain finance
- Learn about regulatory compliance in fintech
- Understand traditional finance and asset management
- Experience smart contract development for financial applications
- Work with blockchain infrastructure and DeFi protocols
- Learn about legal and regulatory aspects of tokenized assets

**Duration:** 4-8 months
**Start Date:** Flexible (typically January, May, or September)
**Location:** Remote/Hybrid options available
requirements: Currently enrolled in Computer Science, Finance, Blockchain, or related program
Strong programming skills in Python, JavaScript, or Solidity
Interest in blockchain technology and financial systems
Good understanding of finance and asset management concepts
Ability to work with complex technical and regulatory requirements
preferredQualifications: Understanding of financial markets and asset management
Familiarity with regulatory compliance in fintech
benefits: Mentorship from blockchain and fintech experts
Understanding of regulatory and compliance frameworks
